summary: Iter 20 — tested the two targeted RemedialFlow improvements end-to-end. (1) GALLERY VIDEO UPLOAD backend + (2) SIMPLIFIED NC EVIDENCE PDF backend + optional PUT /ncs/{id}/export-note endpoint. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_gallery_pdf.py with 15 tests across 5 classes (stamp_lines unit tests, gallery video MP4/MOV upload, 415/403/404 negatives, client_id idempotency, export-note auth/length/persistence, PDF ZIP shape, PDF text omits workflow info and contains the required sections, empty-note omission, readable() resilience). All 15 new tests pass. Updated the two tests in /app/backend/tests/test_p5_p6_p8_payments.py (TestP8EvidencePack.test_04/05) that still asserted the removed 'INTERNALLY APPROVED' / 'Original TrustMark observation' / 'Required remedial work' / 'before'/'after' PDF strings — they now assert the simplified PDF shape (NON-COMPLIANCE present, banned workflow/AI/approval wording absent); file now passes 25/25 (1 skipped). Full backend regression at -n 0 after the fix: 281 passed, 4 skipped, 2 pre-existing non-iter20 issues (see below). Frontend (390x844): installer EF-1025 job detail now shows the three evidence buttons (take-photos-NC-01 'TAKE PHOTOS', record-video-NC-01 'VIDEO', gallery-upload-NC-01 'GALLERY') plus submit-evidence-NC-01 — gallery testID resolves and renders a Btn with image icon alongside the preserved Camera/Video buttons. Employee project detail NC card (expanded) renders export-note-NC-01 textarea and export-note-save-NC-01 button; filling the field, clicking save triggers PUT /ncs/{id}/export-note and shows a 'PDF note saved' toast. One video per NC behaviour, upload-progress wiring, native file picker and offline queue state machine are covered by backend tests + code review (web preview cannot drive native pickers / FileSystem upload tasks). No deployment, no emails, no account changes.

minor.issue: 9 collection errors because /tmp/p419977.pdf fixture file is not present in this environment (pre-existing environmental; file is expected to be provisioned out-of-band). Not an iter-20 regression.

Flaky under -n 0: observed (400 'Add at least one photo or video', 200 'assessing') on one run — the second thread's submit raced ahead of the photo's background _process_file settling. The code path with 3-layer idempotency still prevents duplicate assessments; the race is in the test's timing, not the server. Previous iter-19 report also flagged flakiness; re-run alone usually passes.

action_items: No code fixes required for iter-20 scope. All 7 review checkpoints verified: gallery MP4+MOV upload, kind:video+non-video bytes -> 415, same client_id idempotency, cross-installer 403, gallery-photo stamp 'DATE TAKEN: NOT AVAILABLE' / 'GPS: NOT AVAILABLE (GALLERY UPLOAD)' and the '(FROM FILE, NOT VERIFIED)' variant, in-app camera stamp unchanged, Admin PDF export: ZIP has NC-xx_*.pdf + Videos/*.mp4, PDF omits APPROVED/Approved/AI/Employee/status/confidence/stamped-with/reviewer wording, PDF contains address + 'Project Reference: ' + 'NC Reference: ' + 'NON-COMPLIANCE' + original TrustMark wording + 'REMEDIATION PHOTOGRAPHS' (+ 'REMEDIATION NOTE' when set, omitted when empty), evidence_pack.readable() drops corrupt bytes, PUT /ncs/{id}/export-note employee->200 / installer->403 / >600 chars->422 / stored on project.ncs[].export_note.
Pre-existing: provision /tmp/p419977.pdf so test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.py setup fixtures can run (environmental, unrelated to iter-20).

Pre-existing (iter-19 known flake): consider adding a small post-upload settle (e.g., poll /files/{id}.processing=='ready' or at least a 300ms sleep) inside test_iter18_submit_restore.py::TestSubmitExpect::test_e_two_concurrent_submits_one_assessment to stabilise the race. Not an iter-20 regression.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/media.py:28-49 stamp_lines() correctly treats gallery differently from in-app camera: for gallery, DATE line is 'NOT AVAILABLE' when captured_at is null (never falls back to datetime.now), and GPS line is ALWAYS 'NOT AVAILABLE (GALLERY UPLOAD)' regardless of lat/lng supplied by the client — defensive against clients that incorrectly stamp a gallery import with current coords. In-app-camera path unchanged.

backend/evidence_pack.py:81-154 nc_pdf() has no reference to AI/approval/status/confidence/reviewer anywhere; only inserts the four required sections and the optional REMEDIATION NOTE (lines 149-151). readable() (lines 29-38) protects the export against corrupt bytes by try/convert — verified by iter20 unit test.

backend/server.py:794-822 upload_evidence: enforces source=='gallery' only for installers; computes location_verified strictly as (source=='in_app_camera' AND lat AND lng AND accuracy_m<=50). A client passing lat/lng with source:gallery gets location_verified=false (verified by test_mp4_gallery_upload_sets_active_video). _sniff() rejects a PNG masquerading as video/mp4 — 415 verified.

backend/server.py:829-835 PUT /ncs/{nc_id}/export-note: Pydantic ExportNoteIn with max_length=600 (422 verified for 601 chars); dep=staff -> installer 403; empty-string accepted (section omitted in PDF).

frontend/src/components/NCCard.tsx:162-168 preserves the 3-button row (Camera/Video/Gallery) under one visual group; new 'Gallery' button has testID gallery-upload-NC-xx (verified in UI). captured_at from EXIF only, lat/lng forcibly null when source=gallery (lines 65-72) — client cannot accidentally claim GPS on imported media.

frontend/src/components/StaffNCCard.tsx:24-37 PUT /ncs/{nc.id}/export-note on save; multiline Field with maxLength=600 matches backend validation; save button testID export-note-save-NC-xx is only rendered when dirty — verified by UI test that typing enables the button and clicking it fires a 'PDF note saved' toast.
